question: Add `otlp` and `mcp` to the interface vocabulary?
why: OTLP is defined over gRPC and HTTP transports with a Protocol Buffers schema, so rest names only part of it: Honeycomb accepts OTLP over gRPC, HTTP/protobuf and HTTP/JSON, Axiom over HTTP at /v1/traces, /v1/logs and /v1/metrics, and Better Stack over HTTP at /v1/traces, /v1/metrics and /v1/logs. MCP is a JSON-RPC 2.0 based protocol carried over stdio or Streamable HTTP, not a REST API: Honeycomb runs a hosted server at https://mcp.honeycomb.io/mcp (free plan included), Better Stack at https://mcp.betterstack.com (every plan, free included) and UptimeRobot at https://mcp.uptimerobot.com/mcp. The four records list rest and name OpenTelemetry and MCP in interface_detail or tooling.
